title: Shared UI preference sync race fix
summary: Prevent stale shared UI preference refreshes from reverting freshly clicked layout editor panel decisions or other program-owned UI preferences.
reason: Layout editor decisions and other WebView UI preferences are stored in localStorage and mirrored through the backend UI-preferences route. In Tauri, a periodic remote refresh could apply an older backend value during the debounce window before the local change posted, causing the UI to flash back to the previous state.
behavior_before: A layout editor tile click or other shared UI preference write could update locally, then a stale `/api/ui-preferences` refresh could reapply the prior state before the pending local sync completed.
behavior_after: Pending local UI preference writes are treated as authoritative during the debounce window, the sync hook is installed before page/tab/layout initializers, and local writes are flushed before any remote refresh can apply stale state.
